passport-instructions: Take a photo of the photo page of your passport.
passport-review-hint: Check the photo page is sharp and free of glare.
id-card-front-instructions: Take a photo of the front of your ID card.
id-card-front-review-hint: Check all text is sharp and corners are visible.
id-card-back-instructions: Now flip the card and take a photo of the back.
id-card-back-review-hint: Check all text is sharp and corners are visible.
drivers-license-front-instructions: Take a photo of the front of your driver's license.
drivers-license-front-review-hint: Check all text is sharp and free of glare.
drivers-license-back-instructions: Now flip the card and take a photo of the back.
drivers-license-back-review-hint: Check all text is sharp and free of glare.
selfie-instructions: Hold the camera at eye level and align your face inside the oval.
selfie-review-hint: Check your face is clearly visible and well-lit.
